FAIL_TO_PASS: invalid-none-export-mode: throws when using none export mode with named exports
relative-external-ids: relative external ids are absolutely resolved
dynamic-import-this-arrow: uses correct "this" in dynamic imports when using arrow functions
format-aliases: supports format aliases
does-not-hang-on-missing-module: does not hang on missing module (#53)
duplicate-function-export: throws on duplicate namespace exports
modules-loaded: Throws when adding a chunk after the modules have finished loading
redeclare-import-var: throws when redeclaring an import with a var
side-effects-only-default-exports: Wraps inlined default exports which are rendered for side-effects only
keep-used-imports-from-pure-external-modules: imports from pure external modules that are used should not be omitted
external-synthetic-exports: external modules can not have syntheticNamedExports
external-dynamic-import-live-binding-compact: supports external dynamic imports with live bindings in compact mode
transpiles-react: transpiles JSX for react
chunk-external-dependency-execution-order: Uses correct execution order when several modules in a chunk have external dependencies
named-import-external: warns when a conflicting binding is imported via a named import from external namespaces
make-relative-true: normalizes both relative and absolute external paths when set to true
manual-chunks-include-external-modules3: throws an error EXTERNAL_MODULES_CANNOT_BE_TRANSFORMED_TO_MODULES for manualChunks' modules that are resolved as an external module by the 'external' option
removes-static-attributes: keeps any import attributes on input
no-external-live-bindings-compact: Allows omitting the code that handles external live bindings
external-namespace-and-default-reexport-compat: reexports both a namespace and the default export when using compat interop
